conventions.how: Outer and party walls are thick solid black bands; inner walls are thinner solid black lines. Some thin partitions are dashed.
Doors are not clearly drawn; openings show as gaps in a wall line or as dashed wall segments.
Window at the bottom as a thick wall with a projecting parallel-line sill; same at the lower left.
Circles with a scribble are stoves or basins, outlined bell and oval shapes are WC and bath fixtures, and long narrow boxes are counters or cupboards.
Handwritten names and area numbers, underlined (e.g. Rum, Tamb.).
Long dashed-dotted vertical line is a section or axis line, not a wall.
